records.definition: Adultery; consensual sexual intercourse outside marriage; used in legal and formal contexts.
records.notes: Formal legal term; used in civil and criminal proceedings; less colloquial than 'ngoại tình'.

records.definition: Adultery/infidelity; having an extramarital affair; the most common everyday term.
records.notes: Very widely known and used; appears in tabloids, social media, and casual speech constantly. High cultural salience in Vietnamese society.

records.definition: Fornication/adultery; older legal/moral term for illicit sexual relations.
records.notes: More archaic than 'ngoại tình'; used in older legal codes and traditional discourse.

records.definition: Illicit/deviant sexuality; archaic term for immoral sexual behavior.
records.notes: Confucian moral vocabulary; 'tà' means deviant/evil; increasingly archaic.

records.definition: Obscenity/sexual misconduct; a legal term for indecent sexual acts.
records.notes: Legal term used in Vietnam's criminal code; 'dâm ô với trẻ em' (sexual misconduct with children) is the specific offense.

records.definition: Exhibitionism; the compulsion to expose genitals publicly for sexual gratification.
records.notes: Clinical-legal term; 'phô' means to display/expose.

records.definition: Sadism; deriving sexual pleasure from inflicting pain.
records.notes: Sino-Vietnamese clinical term; 'bạo' means violent/cruel.

records.definition: Masochism; deriving sexual pleasure from receiving pain.
records.notes: Sino-Vietnamese clinical term; 'khổ' means suffering/painful.

records.definition: Fetishism; sexual arousal from objects or non-sexual body parts.
records.notes: Sino-Vietnamese clinical term; not widely known outside psychology contexts.

records.definition: Pedophilia; sexual attraction to children.
records.notes: Legal and clinical term; 'ấu' means young/child; used in criminal law and child protection.

records.definition: Bestiality; sexual acts with animals.
records.notes: Clinical-legal term; 'thú' means animal/beast.

records.definition: Necrophilia; sexual acts with corpses.
records.notes: Highly specialized clinical-legal term; very low recognition outside psychology/legal professionals.

records.definition: Abortion; the termination of a pregnancy.
records.notes: Very widely known; Vietnam has relatively liberal abortion access; high public discourse.

records.definition: Abortion by curettage/D&C; the procedure of surgically removing pregnancy tissue.
records.notes: 'Nạo' means to scrape; refers specifically to surgical abortion methods.

records.definition: Sterilization; surgical procedure to permanently prevent reproduction.
records.notes: Widely known; Vietnam's family planning campaigns gave this high public awareness.

records.definition: The primary crude Vietnamese verb for sexual intercourse; equivalent to English 'fuck'.
records.notes: One of the most taboo words in Vietnamese; extremely productive in expletives: 'địt mẹ' (motherfucker), 'địt con mẹ mày' etc. Also the etymological root of many compound insults.

records.definition: Crude verb for sexual intercourse; slightly less taboo than 'địt' but equivalent in register.
records.notes: More common in southern Vietnam; 'đụ má' / 'đụ mẹ' are its primary expletive forms. Both 'địt' and 'đụ' appear in northern and southern expletives.

records.definition: Crude slang verb for sexual intercourse; slightly milder than 'địt' or 'đụ'.
records.notes: Widely used; somewhat less shocking than the two primary taboo verbs; common in crude humor.

records.definition: Crude slang for penetration/thrusting during sex; literally 'to plunge' or 'probe'.
records.notes: Describes the physical act of thrusting; also used for probing/scouring (as in a drain), which generates the metaphor.

records.definition: Crude slang for sexual penetration; implies a stabbing/jabbing motion.
records.notes: 'Xỉa' normally means to pick (teeth) or jab; in sexual context crude penetration metaphor.

records.definition: Crude slang for penetration during sex; literally 'to stab' or 'thrust'.
records.notes: The stabbing/thrusting metaphor; primarily connotes male-to-female or anal penetration.

records.definition: Crude slang for penetration; literally 'to stick in' or 'plant'.
records.notes: 'Cắm' normally means to plug in or plant; in sexual context means to penetrate.

records.definition: Crude slang for insertion/penetration; literally 'to stuff' or 'cram in'.
records.notes: 'Nhét' normally means to stuff/cram something into a small space; in sexual context is penetration.

records.definition: To ride; crude slang for the on-top sex position; literally 'to ride' (a horse).
records.notes: The 'riding' metaphor is universal; in Vietnamese applies to the cowgirl/reverse cowgirl position.

records.definition: To sit on top (during sex); literally 'to sit up on'; refers to cowgirl position.
records.notes: Milder than 'cưỡi'; more descriptive than metaphorical.

records.definition: To make love; the most common neutral euphemism for sexual intercourse.
records.notes: Very widely used; occupies the same register as English 'make love' — not clinical, not crude, politely direct.

records.definition: Euphemism for sex; literally 'to do that thing'.
records.notes: Extremely common indirect reference; used in all registers from family discussions to tabloid headlines.

records.definition: To make love; a poetic Sino-Vietnamese euphemism for sexual intercourse; literally 'loving affection'.
records.notes: Literary register; common in novels, films, and romantic contexts. More dignified than 'làm tình'.

records.definition: Euphemism for sex; literally 'to go to bed' (with someone).
records.notes: Extremely common euphemism; 'lên giường với ai' (go to bed with someone) is the full phrase.

records.definition: Euphemism for sex; literally 'to sleep with'.
records.notes: Direct parallel to English 'sleep with'; very common in all contexts.

records.definition: Abbreviated euphemism for sexual relations; from 'quan hệ tình dục'; literally just 'relations'.
records.notes: Context-dependent; 'quan hệ' normally means 'relationship/connection'; in sexual context means sex.

records.definition: Euphemism for sex in commercial context; literally 'fun' or 'enjoyment'; used in sex worker contexts.
records.notes: Particularly associated with sex work; 'đi vui vẻ' (go have fun) = buying sexual services.

records.definition: Euphemism for having sex; literally 'go into a room' (together).
records.notes: 'Vào phòng' in context of dating or sex work clearly implies sexual activity.

records.definition: Euphemism for sexual intimacy; literally 'to be close/intimate with'.
records.notes: Extremely mild; requires context to read as sexual.

records.definition: Euphemism for sexual intimacy; literally 'to be intimate'.
records.notes: Even milder than 'gần gũi'; used in news reports and polite conversation.

records.definition: Crude slang for oral sex; literally 'to suck' (as a baby sucks); in adult context means fellatio or cunnilingus.
records.notes: 'Bú' normally means infant suckling; in adult sexual context it primarily means fellatio but can mean any oral sex act.

records.definition: Crude slang for oral sex; literally 'to slurp' (as one slurps soup).
records.notes: 'Húp' normally means to eat/drink with a slurping sound; in sexual context crude oral sex term.

records.definition: Crude slang for cunnilingus or anilingus; literally 'to lick'.
records.notes: 'Liếm' is the general word for licking; in sexual context specifically cunnilingus or anilingus.

records.definition: Crude slang for fellatio; literally 'to blow a horn/trumpet'.
records.notes: Direct parallel to English 'blow job' (blow a horn = fellatio); very widely understood.

records.definition: Crude slang for fellatio; literally 'to blow a flute'.
records.notes: Variant of 'thổi kèn'; the flute metaphor emphasizes a more specific cylindrical shape.

records.definition: Extremely crude term for cunnilingus; combines 'liếm' (lick) with the most taboo word for vagina.
records.notes: Very vulgar compound; the use of 'lồn' makes this among the most explicit oral sex terms.

records.definition: Extremely crude term for fellatio; combines 'bú' (suck) with the most taboo word for penis.
records.notes: One of the most explicit terms; 'bú cặc' is both a description of the act and a component of insults.

records.definition: Abbreviated crude slang for fellatio; literally 'to blow'.
records.notes: The bare verb 'thổi' in sexual context is a shorthand for 'thổi kèn'; widely understood abbreviation.

records.definition: Masturbation; literally 'to pleasure oneself'; very common informal term.
records.notes: The most common colloquial term for masturbation; 'tự sướng' is also used metaphorically for self-satisfaction in non-sexual contexts.

records.definition: Masturbation; literally 'to handle oneself' or 'deal with it yourself'.
records.notes: 'Xử' means to handle/deal with; humorous euphemism implying managing one's own sexual needs.

records.definition: Male masturbation; literally 'hand rotation/spinning'; refers to the stroking motion.
records.notes: 'Quay tay' (rotate hand) describes the manual motion; very commonly understood internet-era term.

records.definition: Female masturbation; literally 'to type' (on a keyboard); slang comparing the motion of fingering to typing.
records.notes: Internet-era coinage; the keyboard metaphor is distinctly modern. Primarily refers to female masturbation.

records.definition: Euphemism for masturbation or satisfying sexual urges; literally 'to resolve' or 'sort out'.
records.notes: Very indirect; 'giải quyết' is the general verb for solving problems; in sexual context is masturbation or sexual relief.

records.definition: Euphemism for relieving sexual tension; literally 'to release' or 'unblock'.
records.notes: 'Giải tỏa' means to release tension or clear a blockage; as sexual euphemism means masturbation or sex.

records.definition: To orgasm; literally 'to reach the peak/summit'; by far the most common colloquial expression for orgasm.
records.notes: Extremely widely used; 'lên đỉnh' dominates across social media, slang, and even some mainstream media. Very high internet/youth adoption.

records.definition: Extremely crude phrase for anal intercourse; combines the most crude sex verb with crude anus term.
records.notes: Maximum crudeness; both component words are among the most taboo in Vietnamese.

records.definition: Crude phrase for anal intercourse; 'đụ' + clinical anus term.
records.notes: Mixes the crude verb 'đụ' with the more clinical 'hậu môn'; slightly less crude than 'địt lỗ đít'.

records.definition: Crude slang for cunnilingus; literally 'to eat'; 'ăn' in sexual context refers to oral sex on a woman.
records.notes: 'Ăn' (to eat) in sexual context = cunnilingus; context-dependent but widely understood.

records.definition: Crude slang related to swallowing semen during fellatio; literally 'to swallow'.
records.notes: 'Nuốt' in sexual context refers to swallowing ejaculate; used in pornographic contexts.

records.definition: Euphemism for bathing nude or skinny dipping; literally 'fairy bath'; also used for nude sexual encounters.
records.notes: 'Tiên' means fairy/immortal; the euphemism frames nudity as a divine or ethereal act.

records.definition: Euphemism for satisfying sexual needs; literally 'to resolve/address one's needs'.
records.notes: Common in clinical and sex work contexts; frames sex as a biological need to be managed.

records.definition: Euphemism for sexual satisfaction; literally 'to satisfy one's needs'.
records.notes: Slightly more formal than 'giải quyết nhu cầu'; used in sex therapy and clinical discussions.

records.definition: Transactional sex; literally 'exchanging affection'; a euphemism for paid sexual services.
records.notes: 'Đổi' means to exchange/swap; 'tình' is affection/love; the compound frames prostitution as mutual exchange rather than commercial transaction.

records.definition: To caress; gentle stroking as foreplay.
records.notes: 'Vuốt ve' is the standard word for caressing; mildly sexual in intimate context.

records.definition: To grope; touching/fondling with sexual intent; literally 'to touch and feel around'.
records.notes: Has connotations of unwanted or sneaky touching; can describe consensual fondling or groping.

records.definition: To fondle; to touch and stroke lovingly or erotically.
records.notes: 'Mân mê' suggests gentle, appreciative touching; less crude than 'sờ mó'.

records.definition: To grope or feel around; literally 'to feel one's way'; implies exploratory touching.
records.notes: Suggests furtive, exploratory touching; can imply non-consensual groping.

records.definition: To squeeze; in sexual context means squeezing breasts or buttocks.
records.notes: 'Bóp' is the everyday word for squeezing; in sexual context specifically breasts or buttocks.

records.definition: To knead/massage; in sexual context means kneading breasts or genitals.
records.notes: 'Nắn' normally means to knead or shape; in sexual context refers to erotic massage.

records.definition: Euphemism for sexual exploration/digital penetration; literally 'to explore' or 'probe'.
records.notes: 'Thăm dò' is normally to explore or probe territory; in sexual context means manual genital exploration.

records.definition: To stimulate/arouse; general term for sexual stimulation.
records.notes: Broad term used in both clinical and casual contexts; covers any form of sexual arousal.

records.definition: Foreplay; literally 'prelude' or 'preamble'; the most common neutral term for foreplay.
records.notes: 'Dạo đầu' is also a music term (prelude/introduction); in sexual context = foreplay. Widely used.

records.definition: To kiss; the standard Vietnamese word for kissing.
records.notes: Basic vocabulary; 'hôn' covers everything from a peck to passionate kissing depending on context.

records.definition: To lock lips; passionate kissing; literally 'to lock lips'.
records.notes: Implies more passionate kissing than plain 'hôn'.

records.definition: Deep/French kissing; literally 'deep kiss'.
records.notes: 'Hôn sâu' directly translates to deep kissing; widely understood term for French kissing.

records.definition: To lick lips; in sexual context means licking a partner's lips during kissing.
records.notes: Can be a standalone sensual act; 'liếm môi' is also a gesture of desire.

records.definition: To kiss; informal variant of 'hôn'; more affectionate/baby-talk register.
records.notes: 'Hun' is more childlike/affectionate than 'hôn'; used between lovers in intimate register and by parents with children.

records.definition: To kiss on the lips; specifically lip-to-lip kissing.
records.notes: Specific; distinguishes lip kissing from cheek or other kisses.

records.definition: To steal a kiss; literally 'to kiss secretly/stealthily'.
records.notes: Implies a surprise or furtive kiss; romanticized in Vietnamese culture.

records.definition: To grope/feel around; implies clumsy or sneaky touching.
records.notes: Suggests unsophisticated or unwanted touching; more negative connotation than 'mân mê'.

records.definition: To touch/feel up; a short form meaning to touch sexually.
records.notes: 'Rờ' is the base form; in sexual context means to touch/fondle genitals or intimate body parts.

records.definition: To touch; in sexual context means touching intimate body parts.
records.notes: 'Sờ' is the standard word for touching with the hand; in sexual context has crude implication.

records.definition: To pinch and squeeze; in sexual context a rough playful foreplay act.
records.notes: 'Cấu' = pinch, 'véo' = tweak/pull; combination implies playful rough touching.

records.definition: To bite; in sexual context refers to biting as foreplay or passionate sex.
records.notes: Standard word for biting; in sexual context often about the neck, ears, or during intense sex.

records.definition: To suck (in sexual context); similar to 'bú' but slightly different register.
records.notes: 'Mút' means to suck as in sucking a candy; in sexual context means oral sex; used for nipple sucking also.

records.definition: Semen; the fluid containing sperm ejaculated during orgasm.
records.notes: Standard clinical Sino-Vietnamese term; used in medical and sex education contexts.

records.definition: Sperm; the male reproductive cell.
records.notes: Very well known due to sex education and infertility discussions.

records.definition: Vaginal fluid/discharge; clinical term for vaginal secretions.
records.notes: Clinical term; female sexual fluids are discussed less openly in Vietnamese culture than male.

records.definition: Vaginal secretion; more formal clinical term than 'dịch âm đạo'.
records.notes: Used in gynecological contexts; very clinical.

records.definition: Pre-ejaculatory fluid; Cowper's gland secretion produced during arousal.
records.notes: Known in contraception contexts since pre-ejaculatory fluid can carry sperm.

records.definition: Lubricating fluid; natural vaginal lubrication produced during arousal.
records.notes: Clinical term; also used for artificial lubricants in sex toy/health contexts.

records.definition: Erection; the engorgement of erectile tissue; clinical term.
records.notes: Standard clinical term; 'cương' means to become firm/erect.

records.definition: Penile erection; clinical compound phrase.
records.notes: More specific than 'cương cứng'; used in medical texts.

records.definition: Penile erection; Sino-Vietnamese clinical abbreviation.
records.notes: Abbreviated form; used in clinical and some casual contexts.

records.definition: Erectile dysfunction; the inability to achieve or maintain an erection.
records.notes: Standard clinical term; high recognition due to medication advertising in Vietnam.

records.definition: Premature ejaculation; ejaculation occurring sooner than desired.
records.notes: Very widely known due to men's health advertising in Vietnamese media.

records.definition: Retrograde ejaculation; semen entering the bladder instead of exiting through the urethra.
records.notes: Highly specialized medical term; limited recognition outside urology.

records.definition: Spermatorrhea; involuntary discharge of semen; in traditional medicine viewed as a loss of vital essence.
records.notes: Both a medical condition and a concept in traditional Vietnamese/Chinese medicine; 'di tinh' is considered harmful in Taoist health frameworks.

records.definition: Nocturnal emission; wet dream; ejaculation during sleep.
records.notes: 'Mộng' = dream; widely known; also has traditional medicine significance as involuntary semen loss.

records.definition: Sexual arousal; the physiological state of sexual excitement.
records.notes: Clinical phrase; used in sex education and health contexts.

records.definition: Vasocongestion/engorgement; blood engorgement of genital tissues during arousal.
records.notes: Highly specialized medical term; known mainly to healthcare professionals.

records.definition: Slang for vaginal fluid; literally 'water'; in sexual context means vaginal lubrication.
records.notes: Context-dependent; 'nước' in sexual context means vaginal secretions during arousal.

records.definition: Slang for vaginal fluid/pleasure juice; literally 'pleasure water'.
records.notes: 'Khoái' means pleasure; this is a slightly poetic crude term.

records.definition: Slang for vaginal fluid; literally 'love water'.
records.notes: Slightly romantic euphemism for vaginal secretions.

records.definition: To ejaculate; literally 'to shoot' or 'fire'.
records.notes: 'Bắn' (to shoot) as ejaculation metaphor is universal; extremely common in crude sexual speech.

records.definition: To ejaculate/release; literally 'to launch' or 'release'.
records.notes: 'Phóng' means to project/launch; in sexual context means to ejaculate.

records.definition: To come/ejaculate; literally just 'out'; abbreviated slang for ejaculation.
records.notes: 'Ra' (out/exit) as ejaculation shorthand; used in combination: 'ra rồi' (already came).

records.definition: Wet; in sexual context means vaginally aroused/lubricated.
records.notes: 'Ướt' (wet) describes vaginal lubrication in arousal; very common crude-neutral term.

records.definition: To be wet; literally 'to flow water'; describes vaginal lubrication during arousal.
records.notes: More explicit than bare 'ướt'; emphasizes the flowing aspect of arousal.

records.definition: Hard/erect; slang for having an erection; literally 'hard' or 'stiff'.
records.notes: Direct parallel to English 'hard' = erect; extremely common in sexual speech.

records.definition: Erect; slang for having an erection; literally 'standing'.
records.notes: 'Đứng' (stand up) as erection metaphor; common in casual sexual speech.

records.definition: To have an erection; crude compound; 'đứng' (stand) + crude term for the organ.
records.notes: Crude intensified version of 'đứng'; 'cái' here refers to the penis informally.

records.definition: To be hard/erect; crude phrase; 'cứng' (hard) + informal organ reference.
records.notes: Parallel to 'đứng cái'; crude but extremely common in male speech.

records.definition: To ejaculate; literally 'to spray' or 'spurt'.
records.notes: 'Phun' means to spray/squirt; common in crude descriptions of ejaculation.

records.definition: To ejaculate; literally 'to squirt' or 'spray' (as with a spray bottle).
records.notes: 'Xịt' specifically implies a forceful spray; used for both male ejaculation and female squirting.

records.definition: Internet slang for orgasm; English loanword 'boom' used for the climactic moment.
records.notes: Internet/young adult slang; the explosive sound metaphor for orgasm.

records.definition: To feel high/euphoric; in sexual context means experiencing intense pleasure or orgasm.
records.notes: 'Phê' is a general slang for feeling high or extremely good; in sexual context implies orgasmic pleasure.

records.definition: To feel good/pleasure; in sexual context means experiencing sexual pleasure.
records.notes: 'Sướng' is the general word for feeling good/comfortable; in sexual context means sexual pleasure.

records.definition: To be satisfied/gratified; in sexual context means achieving satisfaction or orgasm.
records.notes: 'Đã' as an interjection expresses satisfaction; in sexual context overlaps with 'sướng'.

records.definition: To orgasm; literally 'to reach the peak/summit'; the most common colloquial expression.
records.notes: Appears in both acts and fluids sections of the dump; extremely high usage. This is the dominant colloquial orgasm term.

records.definition: Lust/carnal desire; literary Sino-Vietnamese term for sexual desire.
records.notes: 'Dâm' = sexually charged; 'dục' = desire; used in literary and moral discourse.

records.definition: Lustful/lecherous; eager for sexual beauty; describes someone with excessive sexual desire.
records.notes: 'Háo' = eager/greedy; 'sắc' = beauty/form; used to describe sexually voracious men primarily.

records.definition: Licentious/sexually dissolute; describes wanton sexual behavior.
records.notes: Sino-Vietnamese; appears in both descriptive and condemnatory contexts.

records.definition: Sexuality; sexual desire and activity generally; the most common neutral compound for 'sexual'.
records.notes: Ubiquitous in compounds: 'quan hệ tình dục', 'tình dục học', etc.; 'tình' = affection, 'dục' = desire.

records.definition: Sexual desire/libido; clinical-neutral phrase for wanting sex.
records.notes: Standard clinical-neutral phrase; 'ham muốn' = desire/wanting.

records.definition: To crave/desire; in sexual context means to crave sex.
records.notes: 'Thèm' is the general word for craving (food, etc.); in sexual context means sexual craving.

records.definition: To be in the mood/aroused; literally 'inspired' or 'inclined'; common for sexual arousal.
records.notes: 'Hứng' normally means to be inspired or in the mood for something; in sexual context = aroused.

records.definition: Sexually aroused; literally 'inspired by desire'.
records.notes: 'Hứng tình' is the explicit sexual compound; more specific than bare 'hứng'.

records.definition: Horny; sexually excited; literally 'to evaporate/fume'; in sexual context means extremely aroused.
records.notes: 'Bốc' (to evaporate/steam) used metaphorically for hot sexual arousal; common slang.

records.definition: Fiery/burning with desire; intensified form of 'bốc'; literally 'shooting flames'.
records.notes: Intensifier for 'bốc'; describes extreme sexual arousal.

records.definition: Horny/sexually aroused; very common crude slang.
records.notes: One of the most common crude words for sexual arousal; appears widely in internet slang; 'nứng' has no clean equivalent.

records.definition: To desire/want; in sexual context means sexual longing.
records.notes: 'Thèm muốn' is more intense than bare 'thèm'; expresses strong longing.

records.definition: Sexual passion/lust; literary term combining 'tình' (feeling) and 'dâm' (sexual).
records.notes: More literary than colloquial; found in classical Vietnamese literature.

records.definition: Sexual/lustful; a Sino-Vietnamese morpheme meaning sexually excessive or licentious.
records.notes: 'Dâm' appears as a standalone adjective and in many compounds (dâm ô, dâm đãng, etc.); Confucian moral vocabulary.

records.definition: Dirty old man; lecherous old person; literally 'old lecher'.
records.notes: 'Lão' = elderly male; 'dâm' = lustful; describes an older man with inappropriate sexual desires.

records.definition: Lecherous old person; variant of 'lão dâm'; literally 'old lustful'.
records.notes: Interchangeable with 'lão dâm'; 'già' is the more common word for old in Vietnamese.

records.definition: Lecherous/horny; literally 'goat'; uses the goat's sexual reputation to mean perverted/lecherous.
records.notes: 'Dê' (goat) as a metaphor for lechery parallels many world languages (Spanish 'cabrón' associations, Greek satyr). Very common insult for sexually inappropriate men.

records.definition: Old lecher; literally 'old goat'; describes an older man with inappropriate sexual desires.
records.notes: 'Dê già' (old goat) directly parallels English 'old goat' as an insult for a lecherous elder.

records.definition: To crave intensely; combining 'thèm' (crave) and 'khát' (thirst); intense sexual longing.
records.notes: The hunger+thirst combination intensifies the craving metaphor.

records.definition: To long for intensely; strong desire, often including sexual desire.
records.notes: Less crude than 'thèm'; 'khao khát' has romantic as well as sexual uses.

records.definition: Mad with love/lust; frenzied sexual passion; literally 'crazy with passion'.
records.notes: Literary register; 'cuồng' = frenzied/mad; used in describing obsessive romantic or sexual behavior.

records.definition: Infatuated with love; obsessed with romantic or sexual desire.
records.notes: Literary term; 'mê' = infatuated/bewitched; often describes romantic obsession with sexual dimension.

records.definition: Lovesick; foolishly infatuated; besotted with love.
records.notes: 'Si' = foolish/infatuated; 'si tình' describes someone blinded by love/desire; common in popular songs and literature.

records.definition: Deeply absorbed in love/desire; intoxicated by passion; literally 'sunk and drunk'.
records.notes: Poetic compound; 'đắm' = sunk/immersed, 'say' = drunk; used in romantic and erotic literature.

records.definition: Desire; wanting; used for both sexual desire and general craving.
records.notes: General desire term; in sexual context means libido or sexual wanting.

records.definition: Sexual curiosity; interest in exploring sex.
records.notes: Commonly used in sex education discussions about adolescent development.

records.definition: Sexual fantasy/daydream; imagining sexual scenarios.
records.notes: 'Mơ tưởng' = to daydream/fantasize; clinical-neutral compound.

records.definition: Sexual imagination/fantasy; constructing sexual scenarios in the mind.
records.notes: More formal than 'mơ tưởng tình dục'; used in psychology and sex therapy.

records.definition: Sexual dream; a dream with sexual content.
records.notes: Non-technical version; includes both wet dreams and non-ejaculatory sexual dreams.

records.definition: Cold/uninterested; in sexual context means having low libido or not being in the mood.
records.notes: 'Lạnh' (cold) in sexual context implies unresponsiveness; parallel to English 'cold'.

records.definition: Sexual coldness/frigidity; clinical term for lack of sexual responsiveness.
records.notes: Clinical phrase extending 'lạnh lùng' (cold/aloof) to the sexual domain.

records.definition: Sexual numbness/lack of sexual feeling; used for hypoactive sexual desire disorder or asexuality.
records.notes: Can describe both the orientation (asexual) and a temporary condition; overlap with clinical anhedonia.

records.definition: Sexually weak; euphemism for low sexual performance or erectile dysfunction.
records.notes: 'Sinh lý' = physiology; 'yếu sinh lý' is a polite way to say someone has erectile dysfunction or low libido.

records.definition: Impotence/erectile dysfunction; literally 'penis paralysis'; clinical term.
records.notes: Strong clinical term; 'liệt' = paralyzed/unable; direct and somewhat harsh way to describe ED.

records.definition: Impotent; helpless; in sexual context means unable to achieve erection; literally 'without power'.
records.notes: 'Bất lực' has general meaning of 'powerless/helpless' and specific sexual meaning of impotence.

records.definition: Virile/sexually strong; in sexual context means having strong sexual drive and performance.
records.notes: 'Sung' means vigorous/energetic; in sexual context implies strong male sexual performance.

records.definition: Attractive/alluring; having sexual appeal; literally 'evoking feelings'.
records.notes: Standard word for sexy/attractive; used widely in media and advertising.

records.definition: Seductive/charming; attracting others through sexual appeal.
records.notes: Very commonly used; 'quyến rũ' has strong sexual attractiveness connotation in Vietnamese.

records.definition: Hot/scorching; in sexual context means intensely sexually attractive; literally 'burning hot'.
records.notes: 'Nóng bỏng' directly parallels English 'hot' for sexual attractiveness; very common in Vietnamese pop culture.

records.definition: Provocative/suggestive; designed to arouse sexual desire; literally 'stimulating and evoking'.
records.notes: 'Khêu gợi' suggests deliberate sexual provocation; used to describe revealing clothing, gestures, etc.

records.definition: Sexually suggestive/arousing; literally 'evoking desire'.
records.notes: Similar to 'khêu gợi' but more about evoking rather than provoking; commonly used in descriptions of seductive behavior or content.

records.definition: Sexual manipulation; using sex as a tool of control or coercion.
records.notes: Modern psychological term; used in abuse counseling and feminist discourse in Vietnam.

records.definition: Dissolute/licentious; living without moral restraint in sexual matters.
records.notes: Literary register; Sino-Vietnamese compound; 'phóng' = unleash, 'túng' = unrestrained.

records.definition: Debauched; living in debauchery; wanton sexual and moral excess.
records.notes: Classical Sino-Vietnamese vocabulary; appears in literature describing historical figures or villains.

records.definition: Promiscuous/dissolute; sexually uninhibited; living without sexual restraint.
records.notes: Confucian moral vocabulary; implies immoral excess; stronger condemnation than 'phóng túng'.

records.definition: Sexual depravity/orgiastic excess; chaotic sexual behavior; literally 'lustful chaos'.
records.notes: Strong moral condemnation; 'loạn' = chaotic/disordered; classical Confucian vocabulary.

records.definition: Spring desire; the sexual awakening and passionate desire associated with springtime; a classical Vietnamese-Sino literary concept.
records.notes: Novel concept: 'xuân' = spring, 'tình' = desire/feeling; the association of spring with sexual awakening is deeply embedded in Vietnamese and Chinese classical poetry (xuân xanh = green spring = youth/sexuality).

records.definition: Spring lust; archaic term for sexual desire awakened by spring.
records.notes: More archaic and explicit than 'xuân tình'; primarily found in older literature.

records.definition: Foolish romantic obsession; being besotted to the point of stupidity; literally 'foolish love/passion'.
records.notes: 'Si' = foolish; 'tình' = love/passion; describes someone whose judgment is clouded by love/desire.

records.definition: Homosexuality; same-sex attraction; the most common neutral clinical term.
records.notes: Very widely used; 'đồng' = same, 'tính' = sexuality/nature; used in law, media, and casual speech.

records.definition: Homosexuality (full clinical term); literally 'same-sex love attraction'.
records.notes: Full formal clinical term; 'luyến ái' = romantic/sexual attraction; used in official documents.

records.definition: Gay male; homosexual man; literally 'male homosexuality'.
records.notes: Standard clinical term for gay men; used in media and official contexts.

records.definition: Lesbian; homosexual woman; literally 'female homosexuality'.
records.notes: Standard clinical term for lesbians; widely used in media.

records.definition: Bisexuality; attraction to both sexes; literally 'dual sexuality'.
records.notes: Standard clinical term; 'lưỡng' = two/both; widely recognized.

records.definition: Asexuality; lack of sexual attraction; literally 'without sexuality'.
records.notes: Relatively new as a recognized identity in Vietnam; growing awareness through LGBTQ activism.

records.definition: Heterosexuality; opposite-sex attraction; literally 'different sexuality'.
records.notes: Clinical term; less commonly needed as it is the assumed default; known among educated adults.

records.definition: Transgender; transitioning gender identity; literally 'change gender'.
records.notes: Widely known; Vietnam has had significant media coverage of transgender issues, especially after legal reforms.

records.definition: A transgender person; literally 'person who has transitioned gender'.
records.notes: Full nominal phrase; standard polite clinical term.

records.definition: Male-to-female transgender; transitioning from male to female identity.
records.notes: Clinical descriptive phrase; 'nam sang nữ' = male to female.

records.definition: Female-to-male transgender; transitioning from female to male identity.
records.notes: Clinical descriptive phrase; less visible in Vietnamese media than MTF.

records.definition: Intersex; having biological characteristics of both sexes; literally 'between sexes'.
records.notes: Growing awareness term; less commonly known than transgender.

records.definition: Non-binary gender identity; not identifying exclusively as male or female.
records.notes: New term; limited recognition outside LGBTQ activist circles in Vietnam.

records.definition: Sexual orientation; the pattern of emotional and sexual attraction.
records.notes: Standard clinical term; widely used in LGBTQ discussions and sex education.

records.definition: Gender identity; one's internal sense of gender.
records.notes: Modern term; widely used in LGBTQ discourse; 'bản dạng' = identity.

records.definition: Third gender; gender identity outside the male/female binary; literally 'third sex'.
records.notes: Applied to both modern non-binary identity and traditional Vietnamese 'bóng' culture.

records.definition: Pansexuality; attraction regardless of gender; literally 'multiple sexuality'.
records.notes: New term; limited recognition outside LGBTQ activist circles.

records.definition: Pansexuality; alternative clinical term; literally 'complete/all sexuality'.
records.notes: Alternative to 'đa tình dục'; even less widely known.

records.definition: Sexology; the scientific study of human sexuality.
records.notes: Academic term; known among educated adults and health professionals.

records.definition: Queer; English loanword adopted by Vietnamese LGBTQ community for non-heteronormative identities.
records.notes: Borrowed directly from English; used mainly by urban, educated Vietnamese LGBTQ+ communities.

records.definition: Derogatory slang for a gay man or effeminate man; from French 'pédé' (short for pédéraste).
records.notes: French colonial loanword ('pédé'); one of the oldest and most widely known slurs for gay men in Vietnamese. Sometimes reclaimed by the community.

records.definition: Derogatory slang for a gay man; variant spelling of 'bê đê'; same French colonial origin.
records.notes: Variant spelling of 'bê đê'; both forms are widely understood; the consonant variation reflects different pronunciations across regions.

records.definition: A gay or gender-nonconforming man; also specifically a spirit medium who is male-bodied but performs in female roles; literally 'shadow/reflection'.
records.notes: Novel concept: 'bóng' overlaps gay identity with the traditional Vietnamese role of the spirit medium who cross-dresses; the two meanings (gay man + spirit medium) are deeply intertwined in Vietnamese culture. Spectrum from derogatory to neutral/affectionate depending on context.

records.definition: An openly gay/obviously effeminate man; literally 'visible/exposed bóng'.
records.notes: 'Lộ' = visible/out; describes someone whose homosexuality or gender nonconformity is obvious to others.

records.definition: A closeted gay man; literally 'hidden/closed bóng'.
records.notes: 'Kín' = closed/private; describes a gay man who conceals his identity; important concept in Vietnamese gay culture.

records.definition: A gay man who is neither overtly visible nor completely hidden; middle-ground.
records.notes: Regional/community term; the gradation between 'bóng lộ' and 'bóng kín'.

records.definition: Effeminate gay man; spirit medium who is male-bodied; literally 'same as an aunt/priestess'.
records.notes: Novel concept: 'đồng' = spirit medium, 'cô' = aunt/young woman; overlaps with the religious spirit medium tradition; can be a slur or an identity term depending on context and speaker.

records.definition: Eunuch; a castrated male; historically court officials in Vietnamese royal courts.
records.notes: Historical term; 'hoạn' = castrated; sometimes used loosely as slur for effeminate or asexual men.

records.definition: Androgynous; neither male nor female; literally 'loves male loves female'.
records.notes: Idiomatic phrase describing someone who is gender-ambiguous in appearance or behavior.

records.definition: Effeminate; limp-wristed; describes an overly feminine male demeanor.
records.notes: Pejorative when applied to men; describes physical effeminacy (movements, voice, mannerisms).

records.definition: Woman; when applied to a man, a slur meaning effeminate or acting like a woman.
records.notes: 'Đàn bà' normally just means 'woman'; as a taunt to men, it becomes a gendered insult for effeminacy.

records.definition: To cross-dress as female; literally 'pretending to be a girl'; describes male-to-female crossdressing.
records.notes: Used for both drag performance and transgender people in informal contexts; sometimes pejorative.

records.definition: Lesbian; shortened from French/English 'lesbian'; widely used informal term.
records.notes: Borrowed term; extremely common in Vietnamese youth and LGBTQ discourse; much less marked than English 'les'.

records.definition: Butch/masculine-presenting lesbian; from English 'tomboy'; the masculine partner in a lesbian couple.
records.notes: Novel concept in Vietnamese usage: 'tom' specifically refers to the masculine-presenting partner in a Vietnamese lesbian relationship; paired with 'les' (femme partner). The tom/les binary is a dominant framing in Vietnamese lesbian culture.

records.definition: Extremely masculine/butch; literally 'coarse male'; applied to very butch women.
records.notes: Pejorative; 'đực' = male/masculine, 'rựa' = coarse; used as a slur for masculine-presenting women.

records.definition: Straight/heterosexual; literally 'straight'; borrowed concept from English slang.
records.notes: Direct borrowing of the English 'straight' metaphor for heterosexual; widely used in LGBTQ discourse.

records.definition: Bisexual; shortened from English 'bisexual'; widely used informal term in Vietnamese.
records.notes: Also means 'marble' in Vietnamese (testicle slang) and exists in other compounds; context determines meaning.

records.definition: Bisexual; literally 'half lean half fat'; describes someone attracted to both sexes.
records.notes: Humorous food metaphor; 'nạc' = lean meat, 'mỡ' = fat; in sexual context means bi; somewhat dismissive.

records.definition: The femme/receptive gay man; the feminine-presenting partner in a male gay couple.
records.notes: Novel concept: specific to Vietnamese gay male culture; 'năng' = the feminine/receptive role in a gay relationship, paired with the more masculine partner.

records.definition: Performed/artificial masculinity; toxic masculinity framing.
records.notes: Modern clinical-social term; growing use in feminist and gender studies discourse in Vietnam.

records.definition: Motherfucker; the most common and most offensive Vietnamese expletive; literally 'fuck [your] mother'.
records.notes: The single most offensive expletive in Vietnamese; universal across all registers when used as profanity; appears in countless variants. Considered deeply taboo.

records.definition: Southern Vietnamese variant of 'địt mẹ'; motherfucker; 'đụ' (southern fuck-verb) + 'má' (southern word for mother).
records.notes: The southern equivalent of 'địt mẹ'; 'má' is the southern Vietnamese word for mother vs. 'mẹ' in the north.

records.definition: Full-form motherfucker insult directed at someone; 'fuck your mother'; adds 'mày' (you, impolite).
records.notes: The most direct confrontational form; adding 'mày' (your) makes it a direct personal attack rather than a general expletive.

records.definition: General expletive; 'damn'; literally 'mother's fate/life'; widely used profanity.
records.notes: Less explicitly sexual than 'địt mẹ'; 'kiếp' = fate/life cycle; used as an all-purpose expletive similar to 'damn' or 'bloody hell'.

records.definition: Bastard/son of a bitch; literally 'dog-born'; strong personal insult.
records.notes: 'Chó đẻ' (dog-born) parallels English 'son of a bitch'; attacks the person's mother's character by implication.

records.definition: You son of a bitch; 'đồ' = you worthless thing + 'chó đẻ'; the 'đồ' prefix intensifies the insult.
records.notes: 'Đồ' is a prefix that intensifies insults by framing the target as a worthless object.

records.definition: Whore/slut; used as an insult for women; literally 'child whore'.
records.notes: 'Con' is a general noun classifier; 'đĩ' = prostitute; used as a devastating insult for women's sexual character.

records.definition: Filthy whore; intensified form with 'thúi' (stinking/rotten) added.
records.notes: 'Thúi' = stinking/rotten; the addition amplifies the insult to maximum vulgarity.

records.definition: Whore; 'đồ' + 'đĩ'; intensive form of the insult.
records.notes: 'Đồ đĩ' uses the intensifying prefix 'đồ'; extremely offensive when directed at a woman.

records.definition: You licentious woman; 'đồ' + 'dâm phụ' (lustful woman/adulteress).
records.notes: More literary/formal than 'con đĩ'; 'dâm phụ' (lustful woman) is a Sino-Vietnamese compound.

records.definition: Extremely offensive insult using the most taboo word for vagina.
records.notes: Self-censored in writing; one of the most offensive possible insults in Vietnamese; directed at any gender.

records.definition: Fuck/damn; a highly versatile expletive and negation in Vietnamese; literally means 'fuck'.
records.notes: 'Đéo' functions as both an expletive and as a strong negation ('đéo quan tâm' = don't give a fuck); extremely productive in Vietnamese internet slang.

records.definition: Intensifier expletive; literally 'spill [the] cunt'; used as an extreme intensifier.
records.notes: 'Vãi' = to scatter/spill; + most taboo vagina word; used as an intensifier: 'đẹp vãi lồn' (fucking beautiful). One of the most common crude internet expressions.

records.definition: Intensifier expletive; parallel to 'vãi lồn' but with penis term.
records.notes: Used as an intensifier in the same construction as 'vãi lồn'; slightly less common.

records.definition: Intensifier expletive; literally 'piss everywhere'; used as an intensifier expression.
records.notes: 'Đái' = urine; 'vãi đái' = urinate everywhere; used humorously as a less-crude alternative to 'vãi lồn'.

records.definition: Cunt face; most taboo vagina word + 'mặt' (face); extreme insult.
records.notes: Attacks the target's appearance by combining face with the most taboo genital term.

records.definition: Dick/cock (directed at male); 'thằng' (male classifier) + 'cặc' (penis).
records.notes: 'Thằng' is a derogatory male classifier; 'thằng cặc' is an insult directed at males.

records.definition: Cunt; directed at female targets; most taboo vagina word with 'con' classifier.
records.notes: 'Con' is a general/female classifier; 'con l*' is the most offensive insult for women.

records.definition: Pervert; freak; 'đồ' + 'biến thái' (degenerate/abnormal); common internet insult.
records.notes: 'Biến thái' (literally 'morphed/abnormal') is also used for 'hentai' in Vietnamese internet culture; 'đồ biến thái' is a very common internet insult.

records.definition: Pervert/lecher; 'đồ' + 'dê' (goat); insulting someone for lecherous behavior.
records.notes: Using the goat metaphor ('dê' = lecherous); 'đồ dê' is lighter than 'đồ biến thái'.

records.definition: Animal/beast; insult comparing the target to a base animal; 'đồ' + 'súc vật'.
records.notes: 'Súc vật' = livestock/beast; 'đồ súc vật' attacks someone's humanity in the context of brutal or immoral behavior.

records.definition: Male prostitute (as insult); 'thằng' (male) + 'điếm' (prostitute).
records.notes: Combines male classifier with prostitute word; attacks male character as venal or sexually promiscuous.

records.definition: Whore; 'đồ' + 'điếm'; variant of prostitute-based insult.
records.notes: 'Điếm' (prostitute) is slightly more colloquial than 'đĩ'; 'đồ điếm' is a common strong insult.

records.definition: Dog; base insult using dog (considered lowly in Vietnamese culture); 'đồ chó'.
records.notes: Dogs have low status in traditional Vietnamese culture; calling someone 'chó' (dog) is a significant insult.

records.definition: Threatening sexual expletive directed at someone; 'I'll fuck you'; an aggressive confrontational phrase.
records.notes: 'Tao' = I (very impolite), 'địt' = fuck, 'mày' = you (very impolite); a direct threatening phrase used in confrontational speech.

records.definition: You [most taboo vagina word]; directing the most offensive genital term at someone.
records.notes: 'Mày' = you (impolite) + most taboo genital word; a direct aggressive insult.

records.definition: Scoundrel/bastard; 'đồ đểu' attacks someone's moral character without specific sexual reference.
records.notes: 'Đểu' = dishonest/scoundrel; used in sexual contexts to describe someone who is sexually dishonest or exploitative.

records.definition: Sexual scoundrel/bastard; 'khốn nạn' (wretch/villain) in sexual context.
records.notes: 'Khốn nạn' = wretch/wretched; the 'tình dục' qualifier adds the sexual dimension.

records.definition: Suck dick (as an insult); directing oral sex act at someone as a degrading insult.
records.notes: Self-censored in writing; combines 'bú' (suck) with crude penis term; used as an aggressive dismissal.

records.definition: Blow [the penis] (as an insult); variant of oral sex insult.
records.notes: 'Thổi' (blow) + crude penis term; aggressive dismissal used in confrontation.

records.definition: Lick [the vagina] as an insult; degrading insult directing cunnilingus at the target.
records.notes: Self-censored in writing; 'liếm' (lick) + most taboo vagina term; aggressive sexual insult.

records.definition: You disgusting thing; 'đồ' + 'tởm' (disgusting); used for sexual predators/perverts.
records.notes: 'Tởm' = disgusting/revolting; often used when rejecting sexual advances or describing sexual misconduct.

records.definition: Rotten/stinking; 'đồ' + 'thối' (rotten/stinking); insult expressing disgust.
records.notes: Similar to 'đồ tởm'; 'thối' means rotten/stinking; used in sexual rejection contexts.

records.definition: Wench/hussy; 'con ranh' is used for women with negative sexual character judgment.
records.notes: 'Ranh' = sly/cunning/naughty; 'con ranh' attacks a woman's character for being sexually manipulative or provocative.

records.definition: Informal term for someone assigned female who presents or identifies as male; 'pretending to be male'.
records.notes: Used in everyday Vietnamese speech; less stigmatizing than some other terms but still informal.

records.definition: Vietnamese slang for a butch or masculine-presenting lesbian; from English 'les' (lesbian) + 'tom' (tomboy).
records.notes: Widely used in Vietnam's LGBT community; contrasts with 'năng' (femme lesbian). Compound of borrowed terms.

records.definition: Clinical/formal Vietnamese term for bisexuality; literally 'dual-sex romantic attraction'.
records.notes: More formal than simply saying 'bi'; used in academic and medical contexts.

records.definition: Feminization; the process of acquiring or emphasizing feminine characteristics, used in medical or social contexts.
records.notes: Used in medical contexts (hormone feminization) as well as social commentary on gender expression.

records.definition: Extremely crude expletive literally meaning 'fuck your mother'; used as a general intensifier or insult.
records.notes: One of the strongest expletives in Vietnamese; extremely common in angry speech. Variant of 'địt mẹ'.

records.definition: Crude insult using the vulgar word for penis; roughly 'you dick' or 'you prick'.
records.notes: 'Đồ' is a classifier meaning 'you [derogatory]'; combined with 'cặc' (crude penis term) forms a strong insult.

records.definition: Female sex worker; the standard clinical-neutral phrase for a woman who sells sexual services.
records.notes: Neutral legal/journalistic term; 'mại dâm' means prostitution. Preferred in media and government reports.

records.definition: Prostitute; a woman who engages in sex work, with moderate stigma attached.
records.notes: More colloquial than 'gái mại dâm'; 'điếm' carries more stigma. Common in everyday speech.

records.definition: Prostitute; a single-word crude term for a sex worker, also used as a general insult for a promiscuous woman.
records.notes: Strong negative connotation; used both literally for sex workers and figuratively as a slur for any sexually promiscuous woman.

records.definition: Colloquial shorthand for a female sex worker; literally just 'girl' but contextually implies prostitute.
records.notes: Context-dependent; 'đi gái' (go get a girl) means to visit a sex worker. By itself 'gái' just means 'girl'.

records.definition: Call girl; a sex worker who is contacted by phone and visits the client's location.
records.notes: Directly calqued from English 'call girl'; common term in Vietnamese urban slang since the 2000s.

records.definition: A woman who sells sex for money; literally 'girl who makes money [this way]'.
records.notes: Euphemistic framing that focuses on the economic transaction rather than the act; less pejorative than 'điếm'.

records.definition: Female sex seller; formal/legal term used in policy and law enforcement contexts.
records.notes: 'Bán dâm' means 'selling sex'; this is the preferred legal phrasing in Vietnamese criminal statutes.

records.definition: To sell sex; the act of providing sexual services for payment, the verb form used in legal contexts.
records.notes: Legal term appearing in Vietnamese law; contrasts with 'mua dâm' (buying sex). Both acts are illegal in Vietnam.

records.definition: Prostitution; the institutional practice of exchanging sexual services for money.
records.notes: The standard legal and journalistic term; appears in law codes and news coverage. Sino-Vietnamese compound.

records.definition: Brothel; a house or establishment where clients pay for sexual services.
records.notes: Literally 'dirt/degraded house'; the common colloquial term for a brothel. Also 'nhà chứa'.

records.definition: Brothel; a house that harbors sex workers; literally 'house that contains/shelters'.
records.notes: Slightly more neutral framing than 'nhà thổ'; both are understood as brothel synonyms.

records.definition: A den of prostitutes; a derogatory term for a brothel or venue where sex work occurs.
records.notes: 'Ổ' means 'nest' or 'den'; the term implies a seedy, hidden place. Carries more stigma than 'nhà thổ'.

records.definition: A madam; a woman who manages or runs a brothel and its sex workers.
records.notes: Sino-Vietnamese term with classical roots; also used figuratively for a scheming older woman. Well-known from literature.

records.definition: A pimp or procurer; someone who controls sex workers and takes a share of their earnings.
records.notes: Used for both male and female procurers; can also mean a manipulative person more broadly.

records.definition: To procure girls for sex; to pimp or broker clients to sex workers; literally 'to lead/pull girls'.
records.notes: Verb phrase describing the act of procuring; used in criminal law contexts as well as colloquially.

records.definition: Sexual brokering or procuring; the formal term for acting as an intermediary in sex transactions.
records.notes: Used in legal and anti-trafficking contexts; covers both voluntary sex work facilitation and trafficking.

records.definition: A client of sex workers; literally 'patron of the pleasure village'; an archaic-flavored term for a brothel customer.
records.notes: Literary/classical flavor; appears in older Vietnamese novels and poetry. Less common in modern speech.

records.definition: To visit a sex worker; literally 'go out and play with girls'; common male euphemism for buying sex.
records.notes: Very common euphemism among Vietnamese men; framed as leisure activity ('chơi' = play/have fun).

records.definition: To buy sex; the formal act of purchasing sexual services from a sex worker.
records.notes: Legal term; 'mua dâm' (buying sex) is a criminal offense in Vietnam under Article 326 Penal Code.

records.definition: Attendant or hostess; in the context of entertainment venues, often implies sexual services alongside formal role.
records.notes: Technically means flight attendant or service staff; in 'bia ôm' and karaoke contexts implies sex work adjacency.

records.definition: A 'beer hug' hostess; a woman employed at a 'bia ôm' bar who serves beer while sitting with and hugging male customers, often providing sexual services.
records.notes: Vietnam-specific cultural institution; 'bia ôm' bars are semi-formal sex-work-adjacent venues widespread in southern Vietnam.

records.definition: A 'beer-hug' bar; an entertainment venue where male patrons drink beer while hostesses sit on their laps or embrace them, with sexual services often available.
records.notes: Distinctly Vietnamese institution; 'bia' = beer, 'ôm' = hug/embrace. Common throughout Vietnam especially Ho Chi Minh City.

records.definition: A karaoke venue where hostesses ('ôm' girls) provide companionship and often sexual services to clients singing karaoke.
records.notes: Vietnam-specific; 'ôm' (hug) signals sexual service availability; common in cities. Regulatory crackdowns have reduced numbers.

records.definition: To see clients; term used by sex workers for the act of providing services to paying customers.
records.notes: Insider terminology used within the sex work industry; 'khách' means guest/customer.

records.definition: To receive/entertain clients; a euphemism for providing sexual services, often used in entertainment venue contexts.
records.notes: Neutral on its surface (means 'receive guests') but understood as a sex work euphemism in appropriate contexts.

records.definition: 'Special services'; a well-understood euphemism for sexual services offered at entertainment venues or by sex workers.
records.notes: Universally understood in Vietnam as a sex service code; heard in massage parlors, hotels, and online ads.

records.definition: A male sex worker kept by a wealthy woman or man; gigolo; literally 'kept boy'.
records.notes: 'Bao' means to keep/sponsor someone; 'trai bao' is a male equivalent of 'gái bao'; increasingly common term.

records.definition: A kept woman; a female sex worker who is financially supported by a wealthy patron in exchange for sexual exclusivity.
records.notes: Distinct from street sex work; implies ongoing arrangement with a sponsor. 'Bao' = to keep/cover financially.

records.definition: Crude slang for a female sex worker; borrowed from French 'cave' but used differently; a derogatory term.
records.notes: Etymology debated; possibly from French via colonial period or from English. Very crude and derogatory; widely recognized.

records.definition: Pornographic; of or relating to pornography; the standard formal adjective for sexually explicit material.
records.notes: Sino-Vietnamese term; appears in law ('xuất bản phẩm khiêu dâm' = pornographic publications). Both noun and adjective use.

records.definition: Pornographic film; the formal term for sexually explicit videos or movies.
records.notes: Standard term in formal contexts; slang alternatives include 'phim sex', 'phim đen', 'phim cấp 3'.

records.definition: Adult film; a euphemism for pornographic movies; literally 'film for adults'.
records.notes: Polite euphemism widely understood; appears in age-restriction labels and marketing.

records.definition: Sex film; the most common colloquial term for pornographic video content.
records.notes: Borrowed 'sex' from English; extremely common in everyday speech among young Vietnamese adults.

records.definition: 'Black film'; slang term for pornographic films, referencing their clandestine, underground nature.
records.notes: 'Đen' = black; implies underground/illicit status. Older slang, somewhat dated with newer terms like 'phim sex' taking over.

records.definition: 'Grade 3 film'; colloquial term for sexually explicit/pornographic content; 'cấp 3' references a restricted rating.
records.notes: Somewhat dated; 'cấp 3' refers to a classification level. Common in Vietnamese slang particularly from the 2000s–2010s.

records.definition: 18-rated film; content intended for adults 18+, implying sexually explicit material.
records.notes: Reference to age-18 restriction; used similarly to 'phim 18+' but shorter form; widely understood.

records.definition: Pornographic image; formal term for sexually explicit photographs or pictures.
records.notes: Used in legal and journalistic contexts; parallel to 'phim khiêu dâm' for the image medium.

records.definition: 'Hot photos'; sexually explicit or nude photographs; very common slang term.
records.notes: 'Nóng' = hot; used for anything from tasteful nudes to hardcore imagery. Extremely common in online Vietnamese discourse.

records.definition: 'Hot clip'; a sexually explicit video, especially one leaked or involving recognizable individuals.
records.notes: Extremely common in Vietnamese internet discourse; 'clip nóng' often refers to leaked celebrity sex videos.

records.definition: 'Sensitive clip'; a euphemism for sexually explicit video content; used in media reporting to avoid blunt language.
records.notes: Media/journalistic euphemism; widely understood as meaning sexually explicit. Common in news articles about leaked content.

records.definition: A leaked video; specifically a leaked sex tape or nude video of a person without their consent.
records.notes: 'Lộ' means exposed/leaked; 'clip lộ' is a major social issue in Vietnam with high-profile cases driving legislation.

records.definition: Erotic literature; sexually explicit written material; literally 'licentious writings'.
records.notes: Sino-Vietnamese classical term; used in older literary criticism; less common today compared to modern euphemisms.

records.definition: Erotic/pornographic image or painting; literally 'licentious image'; an older term for explicit visual material.
records.notes: Classical/literary term; rare in modern speech; appears in historical legal texts banning such material.

records.definition: Striptease; the act of slowly undressing for sexual entertainment; literally 'undressing/shedding clothing'.
records.notes: Commonly used for stripping performances at nightclubs or in pornographic contexts.

records.definition: Striptease dance; the performance of a slow undressing dance for sexual entertainment.
records.notes: Adds 'múa' (dance) to emphasize the performative element; used in entertainment venue contexts.

records.definition: Adult magazine; a periodical publication containing sexually explicit content.
records.notes: Less relevant in digital age; peak before internet. Refers to publications like Playboy equivalents.

records.definition: 18+ content; sexually explicit or adult material requiring users to be 18 or over.
records.notes: Standard internet-era label; used on platforms and in media warnings. Very common in Vietnamese online spaces.

records.definition: XXX-rated film; pornographic film, using the internationally recognized 'XXX' rating for hardcore pornography.
records.notes: Direct borrowing of the 'XXX' rating system; widely understood across Vietnamese internet users.

records.definition: Trafficking in sex; the organized commercial exploitation of sex workers; literally 'trading in sex/lewdness'.
records.notes: Legal and policy term; distinct from individual sex work — implies organized criminal networks.

records.definition: Sexual trafficking; the formal legal term for the commercial trade in human beings for sexual exploitation.
records.notes: Formal legal phrasing used in Vietnamese law and anti-trafficking campaigns; more specific than 'buôn dâm'.

records.definition: Sex slave; a person held in sexual slavery and forced to provide sexual services.
